controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-17T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        AND falco.rule == "Adding ssh keys to authorized_keys"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           host.name,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.name,
           container_id = falco.output_fields.container.id,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
           user      = falco.output_fields.user.name
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
